metadata.title: The relative isoperimetric profile of a unit square with a central square removed
metadata.abstract: We calculate the exact values of the relative isoperimetric profile for a unit square with a central square removed. In other words, given a removed central square of a fixed size, we provide a function which produces the smallest relative perimeter which bounds any possible area within this shape.
